from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/ssml-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"data,size","code":"memcpy(str, data, size); str[size] = 0;","note":"The fuzzer input bytes are copied verbatim into a NUL-terminated buffer and passed to espeak_Synth with SSML enabled."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":569,"var":"xml_buf2","code":"if ((c1 == '&') && ((c2 == '#') || ((c2 >= 'a') && (c2 <= 'z')))) { ... found = ParseSsmlReference(xml_buf2, &c1, &c2); }","note":"While scanning SSML text, entity/reference text from the attacker-controlled buffer is parsed and converted into code points."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":580,"var":"xml_buf","code":"else if (c1 == '<') { ... while (!Eof() && (c1 != '>') && (n_xml_buf < N_XML_BUF)) { xml_buf[n_xml_buf++] = c1; c1 = GetC(); }","note":"When a '<' is seen, the parser copies the tag contents into a fixed-size wide-character buffer until '>' or the buffer limit."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":602,"var":"terminator","code":"terminator = ProcessSsmlTag(xml_buf, buf, &ix, n_buf, xmlbase, &audio_text, voice_change, &base_voice, base_voice_variant_name, &ignore_text, &clear_skipping_text, &sayas_mode, &sayas_start, ssml_stack, &n_ssml_stack, &n_param_stack, (int *)speech_parameters);","note":"The copied tag is dispatched to the SSML tag processor, which may emit embedded commands into the output buffer."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":553,"var":"tag_name","code":"for (ix = 0; ix < (sizeof(tag_name)-1); ix++) { ... tag_name[ix] = tolower((char)c); }","note":"The tag name is normalized into a 40-byte stack buffer, so malformed or long tags are reduced to a bounded local name before dispatch."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":762,"var":"outbuf[*outix]","code":"strcpy(&outbuf[*outix], buf);","note":"Several SSML cases append formatted embedded-command strings into the caller-provided output buffer without an explicit remaining-capacity check."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":602,"var":"buf[ix]","code":"if (terminator != 0) { buf[ix] = ' '; buf[ix++] = 0; return terminator; }","note":"A non-zero SSML terminator causes the clause buffer to be finalized and returned to the synthesis pipeline."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":602,"var":"buf","code":"The returned clause text is later consumed by synthesis and embedded commands are interpreted during output generation.","note":"The attacker-controlled SSML structure drives the downstream synthesis path that reaches the memory-safety sink in the SSML/output handling code."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
